Players Committee card image of [[Luke Skywalker (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may take Darklighter Spin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle or retrieve 1 Force.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/lukeskywalker_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/50d464c03a6e42edb650f994e0d31985ddd171c5 50d464c] (25 February 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
